summary: Application data is stored in Supabase. Firestore is intentionally closed to prevent legacy data access and keep the auth/session model consistent with Supabase Auth.
notes: Firebase remains only for Google Workspace login flows and related admin tooling.
No customer catalog, order, wishlist, review, or notification data is stored in Firestore.
The source of truth for schema and permissions is Supabase plus the Edge Function app API.

firestore.description: All collections are blocked by rule: allow read, write: if false; see firestore.rules.
